name: cx-rules-only~p1
task: Never pick up the box in the other room. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, and whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Absence(target_picked_up) matches “Never pick up the box.” Both preferences are soft: Absence(key_lost) discourages losing the key while the door is closed, and Response(has_door_key, door_open) asks for the door to be open while carrying the key or later. The rule-only warning is valid.

texts: Never pick up the mission's designated box.

Whenever carrying the matching key, try to have the door open then or open it later.
